disambiguation: Not a real-time collaboration tool; it is a mechanism for synchronizing local vault changes with remote CouchDB instances.
extras: Requires manual installation of core files; relies on a separate live-note-preview viewer application for public links.
problem: Users need a secure, self-hosted solution for synchronizing their Obsidian vault across multiple remote databases without relying on third-party services.
summary: A self-hosted CouchDB live sync plugin that keeps notes encrypted on the local machine and allows synchronization across multiple remote vaults.
